passages.title: Dialogue 1
passages.text: Woman: Are you coming to the climbing wall tonight? Man: I'd love to, but I've already promised to help my brother move house. Maybe next week?

passages.title: Dialogue 2
passages.text: Boy: Did you finish that book I lent you? Girl: Not yet, I've been so busy with my guitar lessons that I've only managed to read a few pages.

passages.title: Dialogue 3
passages.text: Man: The weather is perfect for a bike ride today. Woman: I agree, but I think I'll go to the gym instead. I need to get ready for the marathon.

passages.title: Dialogue 4
passages.text: Girl: Are you going to the art exhibition this weekend? Boy: I was planning to, but the tickets are sold out. I'll probably just stay home and paint.

passages.title: Dialogue 5
passages.text: Woman: Do you want to join the chess club? Man: I'm not really into board games. I prefer spending my time outdoors, like hiking or swimming.

passages.title: Dialogue 6
passages.text: Boy: I've finally finished my painting! Girl: That's great! Does that mean you're free to come to the cinema with us later?

questions.question: Why is the man not going climbing?
questions.explanation: The man has a prior commitment to help his brother move.
options: a) He has to help a family member.
b) He has a climbing lesson.

questions.question: Why hasn't the girl finished the book?
questions.explanation: She has been occupied with guitar lessons.
options: b) She has been busy with music.

questions.question: What is the woman's plan for the day?
questions.explanation: She chooses the gym to train for a marathon.
options: a) Go for a bike ride.

questions.question: What will the boy do instead of the exhibition?
questions.explanation: He plans to stay home and paint.
options: a) Do some art at home.
c) Buy tickets for another day.

questions.question: What does the man prefer to do?
questions.explanation: He prefers outdoor activities like hiking.

questions.question: What is the result of the boy finishing his painting?
questions.explanation: He is now free to go to the cinema.
options: a) He is going to paint more.
b) He is going to the exhibition.
